scope: Snapshot of selected claims; not a complete assurance case. Statements are summaries; Lean declarations are authoritative.
specification_revision_note: Generated fixture mirror is pinned below; its generating execution-specs commit has not been independently established. No EELS refinement is claimed.

trusted_components: Lean compiler, runtime, executable and OS
JavaScript host input mapping, account construction, comparator and arithmetic cross-checks
EthereumJS 10.1.3 transaction RLP decoding and signature recovery (@ethereumjs/tx and transitive cryptography)
EthereumJS 10.1.3 account encoding and MPT hashing (@ethereumjs/util and @ethereumjs/vm and transitive dependencies)
limits: Empty bytecode; zero-value restricted signed transactions, type 0/1/2
No formal refinement to EELS, no general account or transaction validation, receipt or rollback semantics
Type 3 blob and type 4 authorisation transactions unsupported
Published empty logs hash is compared to a fixed empty-log hash; general log/receipt execution is not checked
Fixture is a mirror, generator revision not established
replay.reproduce: See scripts/eels/README.md; run replay and scripts/eels/selftest.mjs; then python3 scripts/check-assurance.py --result .lake/eels/lean-state-results.json
